info.name: Retrieve an attachment with the given identifier

params.name: fileId
params.description: Identifier of the file to retrieve

params.name: attach
params.description: True to force the browser to download the file, false to inline the content

items.docs: Returns a pre-signed S3 URL with a redirect status code (HTTP 302) to allow the client to download the file directly from S3.

info.name: Rename a file (implemented for Salesforce only)

params.name: fileId
params.description: Identifier of the file to rename

params.name: name
params.description: The new name of the file

items.docs: Rename a file (implemented for Salesforce only)

info.name: Delete the attachment with the given identifier

params.name: fileId
params.description: Identifier of the attachment to delete

items.docs: Delete the attachment with the given identifier

params.name: fileId
params.description: Identifier of the file to retrieve metadata for

items.docs: Returns metadata for the attachment. Currently includes EXIF data for image and video formats that carry EXIF (JPEG, TIFF, WebP, HEIC/HEIF, PNG, QuickTime, MP4, AVI, M4V). The exif section is empty for supported formats that contain no EXIF data.
